payload.body: Working pattern Jim asked for and that paid off: before implementing a batch of UI asks, dispatch a planning partner (Plan subagent) to spec every item and choose the build order, then implement one at a time. On the six-ask pass it corrected three claims in my own briefing — the 1239px media block does not override table padding (the 859px one overrides grid-template-rows), the tray was a broken control rather than a spacing nit, and the banker total badge covered the banker FIRST card at every width, not only in third-card rounds. It also set the order by blast radius: rail gutter first because it changes the felt box everything else is measured against, the behavioural change last because it renumbers tabIndex across three files, and asks 2 and 3 merged into one PR because a button with no behaviour is not reviewable.
